sentences.en: Fadil was raised by a single mother in a chaotic household.
sentences.zh: 1. 法迪尔在一个混乱的家庭中由单身母亲抚养长大。

sentences.en: Algiers is the bustling chaotic capital of Algeria.
sentences.zh: 2. 阿尔及尔是阿尔及利亚这个喧嚣而混乱的首都。

sentences.en: For the first time in their chaotic marriage, Dania said no to Fadil.
sentences.zh: 3. 在他们混乱的婚姻中，丹尼亚第一次对法迪尔说不。

phrases.zh: 1. 处在一个混乱的状态下：处于混乱之中
